append_findings.claim: 069's filed graphite-film variant described 070's gamma-held-0.20 cases. None float. R 30 optimistic still needs density factor 1.659, to 1357 kg/m3. 071 carries the thermal result this variant was missing. Above Vc 2, CR-1457 governs by shear crimping and sets the knockdown to 1, so 070's gamma = 1 branch matches the handbook, with the named limit that the rule is not this film on CR-III and not a closed 20 to 30 m sphere. DOI 10.2514/3.5568 and DOI 10.2514/3.1932 do not govern that step. On the aluminum core every gamma-step case is thermally infeasible. At 070's geometry the thermal margin is 0.536. Face density cannot release it. A core expansion at or below 12.2e-6 per K would release it at this stiffness. At that boundary, R 20 optimistic still needs a face-density factor of 3.467 at concept and 3.137 at TRL 7, to 649 and 717 kg/m3, and the core thickness is the search floor. On CR-III the graphite variant is infeasible. Its condition is a core with matched expansion. 072 tests real cores of that kind. The filed 069 page is unchanged. This delta reconciles it.
